notes.title: "Deitydead:Elder Trial" mobile app version is in development
notes.notes:
Thank you to all the players for accompanying us over the past six months! From the early stages of developing "Deitydead," we’ve always planned to bring the game to mobile platforms so that you can enjoy it anytime, anywhere.

The mobile version of "Deitydead" will offer the exact same gameplay experience as the PC version, with controls specifically adapted for mobile. Players will be able to control their characters by simply touching any part of the screen.

Currently, the app version is in the early stages of development, and the release date is yet to be determined—stay tuned!

(It will be available on the TAPTAP platform, but it's still under review. This is our first mobile game, so the development process is moving a bit slowly...)
